newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal Z hopes for Isuzu deal.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal Z hopes for Isuzu deal.

text.p: Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA hopes to sign a contract on building a plant for Japanese Isuzu Corp, which wants to manufacture diesel engines in southern Poland, Mostostal said.
"There is a very good chance that the issue of the contract will be finalised within the next several weeks," Adam Konopka, a director at Mostostal, told Reuters on Monday.
He did not name the value of the contract. @
Konopka said Mostostal and Japanese firm Shimizu, which supervises Izusu's investment in Poland, had already signed a 10.5 million zloty contract on preparatory work on the planned plant.
Isuzu plans to produce 300,000 diesel engines in the plant near the southern city of Tychy by 2000.
